ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central light-intensity region; localized low-intensity clusters at both distal tips; curvilinear dark-pixel trajectories on the right lobe; vertical low-intensity gradient adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle of approximately 35 degrees with moderate vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; significant macro-scale jagged indentation on the outer lateral margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex posterior curve transitioning to a steep upward (cranial) sweep at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white circular pixel clusters localized on the dark-pigmented outer distal tip of the right lobe; scattered dark punctate marks within the central white region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of at least four parallel, dark-pixel curvilinear rake marks located on the right lobe, extending from the medial region toward the outer edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large irregular structural indentation/asymmetry on the outer margin of the left fluke lobe; multiple parallel rake marks on the right lobe surface.
